from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.Debate(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=4, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.WORKER_24_ROLE_A_PROMPT, prompt_custom.WORKER_24_ROLE_B_PROMPT, prompt_custom.WORKER_24_ROLE_C_PROMPT, prompt_custom.WORKER_24_ROLE_D_PROMPT], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.AGG_DEBATE_24_PROMPT, n_rounds=3)
        draft = await debate(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.REFINE_24_PROMPT, prompt_custom.FORMAT_24_PROMPT])
        solution = await seq(draft["response"] if draft and draft.get("response") else problem)
        return (solution["response"] if solution and solution.get("response") else "```\ncannot form 24\n```"), {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
